weatherPoints.label: Glacier area near the Schwarze Schneid, Rettenbach/Tiefenbach glaciers (approx.)

source.note: Search summaries: 146 slope km and 31 lifts — '9 gondolas and trams' (stored under gondolas; cable cars not split out), 14 chairlifts (one 8-seat, four high-speed 6-seat, seven high-speed quads, two doubles) and 8 surface lifts. Total capacity 71,368 persons/hour per skiresort.info (https://www.skiresort.info/ski-resort/soelden/ski-lifts/); the 10-seat Giggijochbahn alone carries 4,500/hour.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools and rental shops operate at the bases

character: A high ski area at the head of the Ötztal in Tyrol that combines the Rettenbach and Tiefenbach glaciers with the lower Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl sectors. The Rettenbach glacier hosts the Alpine Ski World Cup season opener each October, and the Gaislachkogl top station (3,058 m) houses the ice Q restaurant and the 007 ELEMENTS James Bond installation.
learning: Reference note: ski schools and beginner areas exist in Sölden (the glacier and Giggijoch have easier runs), but much of the area is intermediate. Confirm lesson products.
